specs.Header: This Xiaomi Fire QLED features a Smart Fire OS, offering stunning FantastiQLED.
specs.KSP Visual: With the Smart Fire OS and stunning FantastiQLED, you can experience visuals that come to life on the Xiaomi FantastiQLED.
specs.Quantum Dot Display: Powered by Quantum Dot technology for stunning vibrancy, richer colours, and deep blacks, every scene appears visually spectacular on this Xiaomi TV.
specs.HDR10+: This Xiaomi TV optimises every frame with dynamic metadata for a FantastiQ true-to-life visual experience.
specs.DCI-P3 Colour Gamut: With Hollywood-grade DCI-P3 and 1.07 billion colours, you can experience high-quality images in every frame, enhancing your viewing experience.
specs.Reality Flow: The Reality Flow feature delivers blur-free visuals and smoother transitions, keeping every fast-paced scene crystal clear.
specs.Filmmaker Mode: The Filmmaker Mode disables post-processing to preserve original colours and contrast, just as the director intended.
specs.Alexa Voice Search: Using the Alexa Voice Search feature, you can quickly find, launch and control content with your voice, eliminating the hassles of navigating detailed menus.
specs.Picture-in-Picture Mode: The Picture-in-Picture mode helps you check and keep an eye on any camera in your home without pausing your favourite show.
specs.Voice Control Your Set-top Box: You can switch between set-top-box TV channels and OTT apps seamlessly by just asking Alexa, without the need to switch TV inputs.
specs.Fast Streaming: The Fire TV, Live TV and your favourite streaming apps come together on one easy-to-use home screen, offering simpler navigation.
specs.Peak Performance: Experience smooth performance via this Xiaomi TV you need for swift multitasking, faster load times, and a seamless overall user experience.
specs.Remote Control: This TV comes with dedicated buttons for a smooth and hassle-free experience.
specs.Ports: This TV offers seamless connectivity with multiple ports for all your devices.
